mobile.guard.loading.note: Read in flight. Asserts nothing about whether the member is sharing.

mobile.guard.load_error.note: Read failed (network or relay error). Must not imply anything is shared or not shared.

mobile.guard.host_old.note: Shown when the computer does not advertise Guard to the phone (older Local Operator). Calm, not an error; nothing is implied about sharing state.

mobile.guard.intro.note: Settings section intro. Must say plainly that consent is given per computer and that the phone cannot grant by itself. 'Team' is the Radient Team plan name; 'Local Operator' is a product name.

mobile.guard.review.note: Opens the consent card from the inbox row. Does not answer anything.

mobile.guard.consent_not_signable.note: The host did not offer a signable card for the phone (no operator key on that computer, or already answered). The member answers on the computer. Nothing is shared.

mobile.guard.consent_needs_update.note: The card asks for a data scope this app version has no description for. The phone must never let a member agree to something it cannot show, so it refuses to offer an answer. Nothing is shared.

mobile.guard.prompt_background.note: Phone variant of the core prompt line that points at the /guard command; the phone says Settings. 'Console' is the web product name.

mobile.guard.indicator_waiting.note: First grant pending: nothing is shared yet. {org} is the organization's display name. Phone variant: the core line names the /guard command.

mobile.guard.indicator_unknown.note: The host sent an organization state this app version does not know. Say nothing about sharing.

mobile.guard.share_again_result.note: After 'Share again': the request is not a push; it appears as a row in the in-app Notifications inbox. 'Notifications' is that screen's name.

mobile.guard.card_ask_owner.note: Admin variant of the non-Team card: replaces the call to action. Plain text, not a button; an admin cannot buy for the org.

mobile.guard.card_footer_account.note: Non-Team card footer when the organization's name is not known (RFC copy). When it is known the org-scoped core line is used instead.

mobile.guard.shared_heading.note: Heading above the short labels of the scopes currently shared. {org} is the organization's display name.

mobile.guard.computer_line.note: {computer} is the host's own short name for the computer the phone is connected to, passed through unchanged.

mobile.guard.computers_note.note: Matches the revoke semantics: a stop is per account and organization, not per computer. 'Console' is the web product name.

mobile.guard.revoke_pending_result.note: Local stop committed but Radient was not reached (host status revoke_pending). Truthful: this install is no longer sharing; the server-side confirmation is pending.

mobile.guard.surface_terminal.note: Fills {surface} in 'Answered on {surface}' when the answer was given in the Local Operator terminal app. Not 'this terminal': the reader is on a phone.

mobile.guard.answered_elsewhere.note: Used when the host says another surface answered the request but names none this build knows. Mirrors the shape of 'Answered on {surface}'.

mobile.guard.disconnected.note: Shown when the phone has no live connection to a computer. Says nothing about whether anything is shared.
